atoms.name: Terms and height
atoms.one_line: Root, leaf, internal node, depth, height. Height counts edges: a single node has height 0.

atoms.name: Node-count identities
atoms.one_line: Full binary tree: leaves = internal + 1. Height h holds at most 2^(h+1) - 1 nodes.

atoms.name: Traversals
atoms.one_line: Preorder: node, left, right. Inorder: left, node, right. Postorder: left, right, node.

atoms.name: Rebuild from traversals
atoms.one_line: Preorder gives the root first, postorder last. Inorder splits left from right.

atoms.name: BST property, search and insert
atoms.one_line: Left < node < right. Insert follows the search path, cost is the height.

atoms.name: BST traversals
atoms.one_line: Inorder of a BST is sorted. A BST is rebuilt from preorder or postorder alone.

atoms.name: BST deletion
atoms.one_line: Leaf: remove. One child: bypass. Two children: copy inorder successor, delete it.

atoms.name: BST shape and insertion order
atoms.one_line: Height ranges from floor(log2 n) to n - 1. Insertion order decides the shape.

atoms.name: Counting trees
atoms.one_line: Binary tree shapes and BSTs on n keys are both Catalan: C(2n,n)/(n+1).

atoms.name: AVL trees
atoms.one_line: Balance factor in {-1,0,1}. Four rotation cases. Min nodes N(h) = N(h-1) + N(h-2) + 1.

atoms.name: Operation costs
atoms.one_line: Search, insert, delete cost O(height). Range query on a balanced BST is O(log n + k).

atoms.name: Recursion on trees
atoms.one_line: Base case at NULL. Combine the answers of the two subtrees.

atoms.name: Trees in Python
atoms.one_line: Nodes as objects or tuples. Recursion plus a deque for level order.
